Path to the shared tractoverse theme stylesheet

Source: R/brand.R
tractoverse_theme.Rd

Returns the path to `tractoverse.scss`, the reusable dark theme for tractoverse Quarto / pkgdown sites.

Usage

tractoverse_theme()

Value

An absolute file path.
